defs.def: to keep existing or happening without stopping 持续；继续存在；不断发生

ex.s: I continued to make these pencil marks for years, and when I went off to college, I packed that dictionary in my suitcase.
ex.t: 多年来我一直做着这些铅笔标记，离家上大学时，我把那本词典装进了行李箱。

ex.s: I really did not know whether I should continue correcting him or simply drop the matter.
ex.t: 我真的不知道是该继续纠正他，还是就此作罢。

ex.s: Cloud-seeding companies will continue to exist.
ex.t: 人工降雨公司将继续存在。

ex.s: This form of remembered contact with a book can accompany us during a lifetime and continue to strengthen and shape us.
ex.t: 这种带着记忆的与书接触的方式可以陪伴我们一生，并持续地强化和塑造我们。

ex.s: Discover why artists and photographers continue to be drawn to this special place.
ex.t: 探索为什么艺术家和摄影师一直被这个特别的地方所吸引。

ex.s: Continued developments in communication technologies were once believed to make the printed page outdated.
ex.t: 通信技术的不断发展曾让人们以为印刷书页将会过时。

ex.s: What might the author continue talking about?
ex.t: 作者接下来可能会谈什么？

ex.s: Yet as the months of reducing waste continued, I did what I could that was within my own reach.
ex.t: 然而随着减少浪费的日子一天天过去，我在力所能及的范围内尽我所能。

ex.s: Even today Mecca's kindness continues to make me smile.
ex.t: 即使在今天，麦加的善良仍然让我微笑。

ex.s: Each of these new steps continued to grow my confidence.
ex.t: 这些新的每一步都在不断增强我的自信。

ex.s: Although the continuing popular appeal of emotional intelligence is desirable, we hope that such attention will excite a greater interest in the scientific and scholarly study of emotion.
ex.t: 尽管情商持续的大众吸引力是可取的，我们希望这种关注能激发对情绪科学和学术研究的更大兴趣。

ex.s: In around 8 A.Q., the Romans built the Colosseum, which remains the world's best known stadium are continues to inform contemporary design.
ex.t: 大约在公元8年，罗马人建造了斗兽场，它仍是世界上最著名的体育场，并持续影响着当代设计。

ex.s: Lose the interest to continue learning．
ex.t: D．残疾不能阻止人对成功的追求

ex.s: Despite the celebrations, though, in the US the jazz audience continues to shrink and grow older, and the music has failed to connect with younger generations.
ex.t: 然而，尽管有各种庆祝活动，在美国，爵士乐听众仍在萎缩并老龄化，这种音乐也未能与年轻一代产生共鸣。

ex.s: Sometimes we lose sight that the music has a wider context,” says Moran, “so I want to continue those dialogues.
ex.t: “有时我们忽略了音乐有更广阔的语境，”莫兰说，“所以我想延续那些对话。”

ex.s: Climate change is a continuing process, so Norphel’s ice reserves will not last forever.
ex.t: 气候变化是一个持续的过程，所以诺费尔的冰储备不会永远持续下去。

ex.s: The resistance to vaccine has continued for decades, and it is driven by a real but very small risk.
ex.t: 对疫苗的抵制已经持续了数十年，它是由一个真实但极小的风险所驱动的。

ex.s: Led by well-known Chinese volleyball player and coach Lang Ping, they have continued to aim high.
ex.t: 在中国著名排球运动员和教练郎平的带领下，他们的目标一直很高。

ex.s: I probably would have continued trying to keep up with him for the rest of my high school career, but when my family moved, everything changed.
ex.t: 我永远无法踢好足球或打好篮球。

ex.s: Human beings will continue to adapt to the changing climate in both ordinary and astonishing ways.
ex.t: 人类将继续以普通和惊人的方式适应不断变化的气候。

defs.def: to keep doing sth without stopping 继续做；不停地干
to go or move further in the same direction （朝相同方向）走，移动；延伸
to remain in a particular job or condition 留任；维持原状
to start or start sth again after stopping for a time （停顿后）继续，再开始

ex.s: Daniel and Rachel suggested that Emily continue her journey by train.
ex.t: Daniel和Rachel建议Emily乘火车继续旅程。

ex.s: There was a silence as Dad continued to drink his tea, and I held my breath.
ex.t: 当爸爸继续喝他的茶时，一阵沉默，我屏住了呼吸。

ex.s: Even at 93, my grandmother still knits blankets for the local hospital’s babies and buys books to continue with her French.
ex.t: 即使到了93岁，我的祖母仍然为当地医院的婴儿织毯子，还买书继续学法语。

ex.s: continue exploring the classical models in history
ex.t: 继续探索历史上的经典模型

ex.s: Many instructors continue to teach using traditional lectures, which lead to lower success rates.
ex.t: 许多教师继续使用传统的讲授式教学，导致成功率较低。

ex.s: Then I turned the page and continued.
ex.t: 然后我翻过一页，继续读。

ex.s: The world won’t survive if this situation continues.
ex.t: 如果这种情况继续下去，世界将无法承受。

ex.s: 32  his own ill health, he continued to coach me from his hospital bed in the days that followed.
ex.t: 32 尽管他自己身体不好，在接下来的日子里他继续在医院床上指导我。

ex.s: Jenna told Jeff to clean it up so they could continue to cook the rest of the porridge.
ex.t: 珍娜让杰夫把它清理干净，这样他们就可以继续煮剩下的粥。

ex.s: Jenna told Jeff to clean it up so they could continue to cook the rest of the porridge.
ex.t: 珍娜让杰夫把它清理干净，这样他们就可以继续煮剩下的粥。

ex.s: It will continue to work with the World Wildlife Fund.
ex.t: 它将继续与世界自然基金会合作。

ex.s: Still, continuing to challenge yourself mentally and keeping your mind busy can only help.
ex.t: 尽管如此，继续在智力上挑战自己、让大脑忙碌起来只会对你有益。

ex.s: Lancom trains your brain to learn efficiently, so you absorb more information while in the app and continue leaning outside of it.
ex.t: Lancom训练你的大脑高效学习，因此你在应用内吸收更多信息，并在应用外继续学习。

ex.s: We’re not just keeping these old devices — we continue to use them.
ex.t: 我们不仅保留这些旧设备——还在继续使用它们。

ex.s: You will want to continue to focus on positive choices.
ex.t: 你会想要继续专注于积极的选择。

ex.s: The parents had done their duty and would probably continue to do so.
ex.t: 父母已经尽了他们的责任，而且可能会继续这么做。

ex.s: Today, the debate continues over how well the gray wolf is fitting in at Yellowstone.
ex.t: 今天，关于灰狼在黄石的适应情况如何，争论仍在继续。

ex.s: Led by Professor Phil Blythe, the Newcastle team are developing in-vehicle technologies for older drivers which they hope could help them to continue driving into later life.
ex.t: 在菲尔·布莱斯教授的领导下，纽卡斯尔团队正在为老年驾驶员开发车载技术，他们希望这些技术能帮助他们在晚年继续驾驶。

ex.s: To continue to stay in Italy.
ex.t: 为了继续留在意大利。

ex.s: This knowledge is passed down through families, which means that new generations continue to use ancient methods of agriculture to maintain the terraces.
ex.t: 这些知识通过家庭传承，这意味着新一代人继续使用古老的农业方法来维护梯田。

ex.s: This happens because electricity continues to leak from the device, even when it is turned “off”.
ex.t: 这是因为即使设备处于“关闭”状态，电流仍会继续从设备中泄漏。

ex.s: Ryan’s foundation continues to attract support from more and more people, so the work of building more wells can go on.
ex.t: 瑞安的基金会继续吸引越来越多人的支持，因此建造更多水井的工作可以继续进行。

ex.s: That's how I continue to get better every single day.” Inspiring others to believe in themselves, Stephen Curry is living proof that what other people think of you does not have to influence what you become.
ex.t: 我每天都在继续这样好转。” 激励别人相信自己，Stephen Curry是活生生的证据，证明别人对你的看法不必影响你变成什么样。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: It has to continue to move, because the way the world works is not the same,” says Moran.
ex.t: “它必须继续发展，因为世界的运转方式已经不同了，”莫兰说。

ex.s: I experienced this when I started switching to a zero waste lifestyle five years ago, as I was living with my parents, and I continue to experience this with my husband, as he is not completely zero waste like me.
ex.t: 五年前我刚开始转向零废弃生活方式时就有这种体会，那时我和父母同住；现在和丈夫在一起也继续有这种体会，因为他不像我那样完全零废弃。

ex.s: After a struggle, she managed to free the vehicle and continued inching along the snow-covered road.
ex.t: 一番挣扎后，她设法把车弄了出来，继续在积雪覆盖的道路上缓慢前行。

ex.s: After you exercise, you continue to burn calories throughout the day.
ex.t: 根据世界银行的数据，中国占全球化肥总消费量的约30%。

ex.s: Six months after suffering our （14）     on the spring practice field， we won our first game and our second， and continued to （15）     ．Finally， we faced the number one team in the state． I felt that it would be a （16）     for us even if we lost the game． But that wasn't what happened． My boys beat the best team in Georgia， giving me one of the greatest （17）     of my life！
ex.t: 在春季训练场遭受（14）___六个月后，我们赢下第一场、第二场，并继续（15）___。终于，我们面对全州第一的队。我觉得即使输了，对我们也是（16）___。但事实并非如此。我的孩子们击败了佐治亚最好的队，给了我一生中最伟大的（17）___之一！
